prompt: We have an AI inference job in Pixhaus that goes through three stages: a draft you've configured but not sent, a running job with a spawned task handle, and a finished job that holds the output image. I want it to be impossible to read the output before the job is finished, and impossible to re-submit a job that's already running — enforced by the compiler, not by checking a status field at runtime. How should I model this? Show me the types.

assertions.text: Three distinct state types model draft, running, and finished
The output accessor exists only on the finished state
submit()/send exists only on the draft state, so a running job cannot be re-submitted
Transition methods take self by value (consume the previous state)
State-specific data (task handle, output image) lives inside the state type, not Option fields unwrapped with unreachable!/expect
No unwrap/expect/unreachable/panic; fallible transitions return Result
